fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released the Railway RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 on their official websites. The recruitment was conducted for 22,195 Level 1 Group D posts. The online application process for Railway RRB Group D Recruitment 2026 was completed from 31 January 2026 to 09 March 2026. The CBT-I examination was conducted from 03 August to 21 August 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination will be able to check and download their Railway RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 once it is released. The answer key will help candidates review their responses and estimate their probable scores before the declaration of the result. The direct link to download the RRB Group D Answer Key 2026 will be provided below after its official release.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 30 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 31 January 2026
  • Last Date : 09 March 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 March 2026
  • Correction Date : 12 to 21 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 03-21 August 2026
  • Exam City Details Available : 10 days before exam
  • Admit Card : 31 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
